purpose: This silver table cleans the bronze nyc_flights capture of the nycflights13 flights data (January-June 2013, JFK/LGA/EWR departures) so downstream flight-delay and on-time-performance analyses can consume typed departure, arrival, and delay fields without re-deriving them from raw decimals and capture metadata.
usage: Consumers should treat dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, air_time, and tailnum as nullable and filter or branch on nulls explicitly (for example excluding null dep_time rows to compute realized delay statistics) rather than assuming every scheduled flight has a recorded outcome; grain is one row per year-month-day-carrier-flight-origin combination.
limitations: Cleanup did not resolve the roughly 3% null rates on dep_time, dep_delay, arr_time, arr_delay, and air_time (4883-5480 of 166158 rows), which reflect flights that never departed or arrived rather than data-quality defects, and the 0.009154 null rate on tailnum remains unresolved; no duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no dedupe logic was applied.
